title: Wings — Lower Cover Stringer Run-Out Reinforcement Ribs 8 to 14, VANTOR-68

ata.title: Wing Box Structure — Lower Cover Panels

abstract: Terminating action for the lower cover run-out inspection: re-profiled stringer run-outs and a bonded and bolted strap over the last three fastener rows between ribs 8 and 14 on both wings.

sections.planning_reason: The repeat ultrasonic survey required by the airworthiness directive is expensive because it needs tank entry, and it does not improve the structure. Operators asked for a terminating action and this Service Bulletin is it. The reinforcement restores the fatigue life of the run-out region to beyond the extended service goal and releases the aircraft from the repeat inspection once embodied.
sections.description: The run-out of stringers 12 through 18 between ribs 8 and 14 is re-profiled from a stepped taper to a continuous tapered pad, and a bonded and bolted strap is added over the last three fastener rows. The stringer kit is replaced by a machined item with the pad integral and the lower spar cap kit is re-drilled locally. The fuel quantity harness is re-clipped 40 mm inboard to clear the pad.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Do the survey of Service Bulletin SLN-57-1017 first and confirm that no indication is present. De-fuel and purge the tank. WARNING: TANK ENTRY IS A CONFINED SPACE OPERATION. DO NOT ENTER UNTIL THE ATMOSPHERE TEST IS COMPLETE. Get access through zones 531, 541 and 591. Remove the sealant over the run-out region and remove the existing stringer kit D5710124822382 on each affected station. Ream the fastener holes of the lower spar cap kit D5710125087378 to the new pattern and do an eddy current inspection of each reamed hole. Install the machined stringer kit and the bonded strap wet with sealant, and let the bond cure at the temperature and time given in the accomplishment instructions. Fasten the strap over the last three fastener rows. Re-clip the fuel quantity harness with loop clamps EN26865-6B on the revised route, clear of the pad. Restore the sealant, close the tank and do the leak check. Do the fuel quantity system operational test and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all VTR-68R2 aircraft still at the original lower cover standard. Embodiment terminates the repeat ultrasonic survey and releases the aircraft from the associated airworthiness directive. The change is not applicable to the twin-engine aircraft or to the shorter four-engine variant, whose bending spectrum does not produce the shortfall.
sections.material_note: Kit K5710-1021-01 contains the machined stringer kits, the strap set, the fasteners and the bonding film. Lead time is thirty-two weeks and the kit is built against firm order only because the population is small. The removed stringer kits are returned to Aeralis for metallurgical sampling.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled 12-year check, or before 48 000 flight cycles, whichever occurs first.
